raw.label: clean
raw.detail: Stop YugabyteDB + Docker Compose stacks, remove all runtime data (ybdb/, voyager-data/, keys, pscript files)
raw.command: bash -c 'echo "🛑 Stopping CDC appliers..." && for p in /tmp/cdc-applier.pid /tmp/cdc-applier-a2b.pid /tmp/cdc-applier-b2a.pid; do [ -f "$p" ] && kill "$(cat "$p")" 2>/dev/null; done; rm -f /tmp/cdc-applier*.pid /tmp/cdc-applier*.log; echo "🛑 Stopping YugabyteDB nodes..." && yugabyted destroy --base_dir=ybdb/ybd1 2>/dev/null; yugabyted destroy --base_dir=ybdb/ybd2 2>/dev/null; yugabyted destroy --base_dir=ybdb/ybd3 2>/dev/null; yugabyted destroy --base_dir=ybdb/source 2>/dev/null; yugabyted destroy --base_dir=ybdb/target 2>/dev/null; echo "🐳 Stopping Docker Compose stacks..." && for f in init-cdc-ybdb-pg/compose.yml init-voyager-postgres/compose.yml init-voyager-mysql/compose.yml init-voyager-mariadb/compose.yml init-voyager-oracle/compose.yml; do [ -f "$f" ] && docker-compose -f "$f" down --remove-orphans 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo "🐳 Stopping ecosystem containers..." && docker rm -f keycloak-ybdb kong-gateway wso2-apim opensearch-ybdb opensearch-dashboards-ybdb init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-zookeeper-1 init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-kafka-1 init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-connect-1 sqlserver init-cdc-mysql-ybdb-zookeeper-1 init-cdc-mysql-ybdb-kafka-1 init-cdc-mysql-ybdb-connect-1 mysql-cdc 2>/dev/null || true; echo "🧹 Removing runtime data..." && rm -rf ybdb voyager-data init-ear/keys init-cdc-ybdb-pg/kafka-plugins init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb/kafka-plugins init-cdc-mysql-ybdb/kafka-plugins init-voyager-postgres/voyager-data init-voyager-mysql/voyager-data init-voyager-mariadb/voyager-data init-voyager-oracle/voyager-data && find . -name pscript -not -path "./.git/*" -delete && echo "✅ All runtime data removed and services stopped."'

tail.label: ysql
tail.command: echo 'Waiting for YugabyteDB on :5433...' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && ysqlsh -h 127.0.0.1
tail.detail: Open a YSQL shell (ysqlsh) — available in every exercise

tail.label: yb-voyager
tail.command: echo '🚀 yb-voyager — run yb-voyager export / import commands here' && exec bash
tail.detail: Open the yb-voyager migration shell (init-voyager-mysql / mariadb / oracle)
